title: From Endomorphism to Galois Generator
content: The parent entry exhibited the Frobenius x ↦ x^p as a ring endomorphism in characteristic p. This file upgrades it to Galois theory: over the prime field 𝔽_p = ZMod p the Frobenius is a field automorphism, hence an element of Gal(K/𝔽_p) = K ≃ₐ[ZMod p] K, and it generates that group, which is cyclic of order n = [K : 𝔽_p]. Mathlib provides the finite-field Galois machinery for an arbitrary finite base; the contribution here is to specialise it to the prime base — where the abstract |base|-power map becomes the honest x ↦ x^p — and to assemble the explicit structure theorem Gal(𝔽_{p^n}/𝔽_p) ≅ ℤ/n.
prerequisites: The parent FrobeniusEndomorphismOQ01 (Frobenius as a ring endomorphism)

title: The prime base collapses to x ↦ x^p
content: FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic is the |base|-power automorphism. Over ZMod p the base has exactly Fintype.card (ZMod p) = p elements, so rewriting with ZMod.card identifies the Galois generator with the parent entry's prime Frobenius x ↦ x^p. The automorphism and the endomorphism are literally the same map — now invertible.

title: Order = group order = dimension
content: orderOf(frob), Nat.card Gal(K/𝔽_p), and Module.finrank (ZMod p) K all equal n. orderOf_frob is Mathlib's orderOf_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic; card_galoisGroup is IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (the IsGalois and FiniteDimensional instances are automatic for finite extensions of finite fields).
prerequisites: IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank and the automatic IsGalois instance

title: Equal cardinalities force generation
content: zpowers_frob_eq_top proves ⟨frob⟩ = ⊤ by Subgroup.card_eq_iff_eq_top: it suffices that Nat.card ⟨frob⟩ = Nat.card Gal. The left side is orderOf(frob) (Nat.card_zpowers), which equals n (orderOf_frob), which equals the group order (card_galoisGroup). mem_zpowers_frob and exists_pow_frob then express that every automorphism is an (integer, resp. natural-number) power of the Frobenius.
prerequisites: An element of order |G| generates G

title: Order exactly n: iterate returns, but not before
content: frob_pow_finrank: frob^n = 1 by pow_orderOf_eq_one. frob_iterate_finrank: pointwise (frob)^[n] x = x^(p^n) = x, chaining coe_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic_iterate (the iterate is x ↦ x^(p^n)) with p^n = |K| (pow_finrank_eq_card) and FiniteField.pow_card. frob_pow_ne_one: no positive power below n is the identity, via orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one and omega.

title: The explicit structure theorem Gal ≅ ℤ/n
content: galoisGroupMulEquivZMod transports zmodCyclicMulEquiv (Multiplicative (ZMod (Nat.card G)) ≃* G for cyclic G) along card_galoisGroup to give a concrete isomorphism Multiplicative (ZMod n) ≃* Gal(K/𝔽_p) sending the generator 1 to the Frobenius. From this the subfield lattice (subgroups of ℤ/n ↔ divisors of n) reads off immediately.
relatedConcepts: subfield lattice of a finite field
